stories.title: Whitespace to Showcase Operational AI Capability at Eurosatory 2026
stories.summary: Whitespace has announced a collaborative initiative with Mattermost, Arqit, and archTIS to deliver an interoperable operational AI and mission workflow environment for defence and coalition operations, debuting at Eurosatory 2026.
stories.why_it_matters: This partnership demonstrates the practical application of sovereign AI in complex, multi-domain defence environments, highlighting Whitespace's role in integrating mission workflows with secure, post-quantum, and zero-trust technologies.
verified_facts: Whitespace is collaborating with Mattermost, Arqit, and archTIS.
The joint capability will debut at Eurosatory 2026 (15–19 June).
The demonstration will take place on the Microsoft stand (Hall 4, G286).

drafts.concise: We are pleased to see Whitespace announce a new collaborative initiative alongside Mattermost, Arqit, and archTIS. This partnership aims to deliver an interoperable operational AI and mission workflow environment designed for defence and coalition operations. The joint capability will make its public debut at Eurosatory 2026, taking place from 15–19 June. By integrating operational intelligence with secure collaboration, zero-trust policy enforcement, and post-quantum security, the initiative addresses the critical need for adaptable technology across connected and disconnected environments. The team will be showcasing this integrated solution on the Microsoft stand (Hall 4, G286). #SovereignAI #DefenceTech #Whitespace
drafts.investor: The defence sector is increasingly prioritising interoperable ecosystems that can function across cloud, edge, and air-gapped environments. Whitespace’s latest collaboration with Mattermost, Arqit, and archTIS is a significant step in this direction, creating a unified operational environment that supports the full Sense, Decide, Act, and Analyse cycle. By combining Whitespace’s mission workflow capabilities with specialist technologies in secure communication and data-centric policy enforcement, the partnership offers a scalable approach to modern military operations. We look forward to seeing the live demonstration of this integrated capability at Eurosatory 2026, where the partners will showcase how sovereign AI can be deployed with measurable impact from HQ to the tactical edge. #DefenceInnovation #SovereignAI #NextWavePartners
drafts.people: Congratulations to the team at Whitespace on the announcement of their new collaborative initiative for defence and coalition operations. Working alongside partners Mattermost, Arqit, and archTIS, Whitespace is demonstrating how sovereign AI can reduce friction between systems and accelerate mission execution. This project highlights the importance of cross-industry cooperation in building secure, interoperable digital capabilities for the tactical edge. The team will be presenting their work at Eurosatory 2026 from 15–19 June, showcasing how their operational intelligence and mission workflow capabilities integrate within a broader secure ecosystem. It is an excellent example of the technical rigour and collaborative spirit driving the team forward. #SovereignAI #TeamWhitespace #DefenceTech

stories.title: Clearway appoint Christian Baumbach as Managing Director of Secontec
stories.summary: The Clearway Group has appointed Christian Baumbach as the new Managing Director of its subsidiary, SECONTEC, to lead strategic development and operations in Germany.
stories.why_it_matters: This appointment signals a strategic focus on the German market and strengthens the leadership team within the Clearway Group's European operations.
verified_facts: Christian Baumbach appointed as Managing Director of SECONTEC.
Baumbach previously held senior executive positions at Safetykleen for nine years.
The role focuses on strategic development and operations in Germany.

drafts.concise: We are pleased to share that The Clearway Group has appointed Christian Baumbach as the new Managing Director of SECONTEC. Christian brings extensive leadership experience from his previous roles in the industrial and environmental service sectors, including nine years at Safetykleen. In this new capacity, he will lead SECONTEC’s strategic development and operations in Germany, focusing on accelerating growth and delivering high-quality security solutions. This appointment marks a significant step in the Group’s commitment to strengthening its leadership capability and expanding its footprint across Europe. Congratulations to Christian on his new role. #ClearwayGroup #SECONTEC #Leadership
drafts.investor: The Clearway Group continues to strengthen its European operations with the appointment of Christian Baumbach as Managing Director of SECONTEC. Christian joins the team with a proven track record of driving operational excellence and commercial growth, most recently serving in senior executive roles at Safetykleen. His focus will be on the strategic development of the German market, a key region for the Group’s ongoing expansion. By investing in experienced leadership, Clearway is well-positioned to deliver sustainable growth and enhance its service delivery across its international portfolio. We look forward to seeing the impact of his leadership on the business. #ClearwayGroup #StrategicGrowth #BusinessDevelopment
drafts.people: We are delighted to welcome Christian Baumbach to the team as the new Managing Director of SECONTEC. Christian brings a wealth of experience in business transformation and high-performing team development, having spent the last nine years in senior leadership at Safetykleen. His expertise will be instrumental as he leads SECONTEC’s operations in Germany, focusing on customer relationships and the delivery of innovative security solutions. Please join us in welcoming Christian to the Group. #ClearwayGroup #Leadership #TeamGrowth

stories.title: Petainer at Watercoolers Europe 2025 | BPA-Free PET Watercooler Bottles & Preforms
stories.summary: Petainer is set to exhibit at the Watercoolers Europe Trade Show in Milan on 7 November 2025, focusing on its BPA-free PET watercooler solutions ahead of the upcoming 2026 BPA ban on polycarbonate bottles.
stories.why_it_matters: The event highlights Petainer's strategic positioning to support the industry's regulatory transition to safer, more sustainable packaging materials, while showcasing their PET preform technology to help producers reduce logistics costs and carbon footprints.
verified_facts: Petainer will exhibit at Watercoolers Europe 2025 in Milan on 7 November 2025.
The company is promoting BPA-free PET alternatives in response to the mid-2026 BPA ban on polycarbonate watercooler bottles.
Petainer will showcase PET preforms designed to help customers blow their own bottles and reduce freight emissions.

drafts.concise: Petainer will be at the Watercoolers Europe Trade Show in Milan on 7 November 2025. With the BPA ban on polycarbonate watercooler bottles taking effect in mid-2026, the team will be at Stand S11 to discuss how PET offers a ready-to-implement, sustainable alternative. In addition to their bottle range, Petainer will present PET preforms, which allow producers to blow their own bottles, helping to reduce logistics costs and freight emissions. It is a timely opportunity for the industry to explore future-proof packaging solutions. #Petainer #PackagingInnovation #Sustainability
drafts.investor: As the industry prepares for the mid-2026 BPA ban on polycarbonate watercooler bottles, Petainer is positioning its PET solutions as a key alternative for the market. At the upcoming Watercoolers Europe Trade Show in Milan on 7 November, the company will demonstrate how its PET preforms enable producers to bring blowing capacity in-house, effectively reducing per-unit costs and freight emissions. This focus on operational efficiency and regulatory compliance highlights Petainer’s commitment to building a more resilient and sustainable supply chain for its partners. #Petainer #SustainablePackaging #SupplyChain
drafts.people: The Petainer team is heading to Milan for the Watercoolers Europe Trade Show on 7 November 2025. Our colleagues will be stationed at Stand S11 to provide expert guidance on the transition to BPA-free PET watercooler bottles ahead of the 2026 regulatory deadline. Whether discussing the benefits of PET or the operational advantages of in-house preform blowing, the team is ready to support producers in navigating this industry shift. We look forward to seeing the team share their expertise on low-carbon packaging solutions with the wider hydration industry. #Petainer #WatercoolersEurope #Packaging

stories.title: Introducing Project Conexus: the unified targeting operating system for NATO warfighters
stories.summary: Whitespace has unveiled Project Conexus, a cloud-centric targeting operating system designed for NATO warfighters, developed in collaboration with a consortium including Oracle, Mattermost, Arqit, Quantum Systems, Janes, and Esri.
stories.why_it_matters: Project Conexus addresses the critical 'connection problem' in modern defence by providing a unified, open-standards foundation that integrates disparate sensors, data, and AI models to accelerate the decision-making cycle for coalition operations.
verified_facts: Project Conexus was introduced at the Oracle Defence Summit in Brussels on June 25th, 2026.
The consortium includes Oracle, Mattermost, Arqit, Quantum Systems, Janes, and Esri.
The platform is built on Whitespace's Collective operating system.
Project Conexus is designed to deploy across various cloud and edge infrastructures at multiple classification levels.
warnings: The article is a company-authored announcement, which may present the project's capabilities in a highly favourable light.

drafts.concise: Whitespace has announced the launch of Project Conexus, a unified targeting operating system designed to enhance interoperability for NATO warfighters. Unveiled at the Oracle Defence Summit in Brussels, the platform aims to bridge the gap between sensing, intelligence, and decision-making by providing a common, cloud-centric foundation. Developed by a consortium including Oracle, Mattermost, Arqit, Quantum Systems, Janes, and Esri, Conexus is built on Whitespace’s Collective operating system. By leveraging open standards, the platform is engineered to integrate disparate data sources and applications, allowing commanders to maintain decision advantage in complex, multi-domain environments. This initiative represents a significant step toward creating a more connected and resilient infrastructure for coalition defence operations. #DefenceTech #SovereignAI #Whitespace
drafts.investor: The launch of Project Conexus marks a strategic expansion for Whitespace, demonstrating the scalability of its Collective operating system within the high-stakes defence sector. By leading a consortium that includes industry leaders like Oracle and Esri, Whitespace is positioning its technology as a foundational layer for NATO-aligned alliance operations. The platform addresses a critical market need for interoperability, moving beyond fragmented tools to a unified, evergreen operating environment. This collaborative approach not only accelerates capability delivery but also establishes a repeatable model for integrating third-party applications into a secure, sovereign framework. As the defence community prioritises the speed of the decision cycle, Whitespace’s focus on open-standards architecture provides a clear pathway for long-term integration and operational relevance. #DefenceTech #SovereignAI #Innovation
drafts.people: Congratulations to the team at Whitespace on the successful unveiling of Project Conexus at the Oracle Defence Summit. This project highlights the power of collaborative innovation, bringing together a diverse consortium of partners—including Oracle, Mattermost, Arqit, Quantum Systems, Janes, and Esri—to solve the complex challenge of data integration in modern defence. As Andrew Webber, Chief Partnerships Officer at Whitespace, noted, the initiative was driven by a shared commitment to act on recognised operational needs rather than waiting for formal requirements. By building a common foundation that keeps the commander’s judgement at the centre, the team is making a tangible contribution to the speed and efficacy of coalition decision-making. We look forward to seeing how this open-standards approach continues to evolve. #DefenceTech #Collaboration #Whitespace
